S7.01.note: The sidebar button itself was not traced; the label is taken from the command palette entry. The centring rule is in apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx around line 7637.
steps: Sign in and select New chat from the sidebar, or open the command palette and choose New chat.
Look at the empty chat before typing anything.
Check that the greeting and the composer sit in the middle of the area, with no empty transcript above them.
Widen and narrow the window and check the start view stays centred.
S7.01.where: Sidebar or command palette > New chat, then look at the empty start screen

S7.02.note: Width rule is in apps/web/app/globals.css and apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx; the exact max width value was not read.
steps: Open a conversation that has long assistant replies.
Make the window very wide.
Check that the message text stays in a centred column of limited width rather than running edge to edge.
S7.02.where: Inner layout rule; visible in any conversation with long replies

S7.03.needs: a conversation with a wide table
S7.03.note: Found the table components in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/MarkdownTable.tsx and MarkdownContent.tsx, but found no control that switches to a full-width data layout. Searched for full-width and data-view toggles in the chat folders.

S7.04.needs: a conversation that produces an artifact
S7.04.note: The artifact panel code exists (ArtifactsPanel.tsx), but the control that opens an artifact beside the conversation was not traced to a visible label.

S7.05.note: ResearchPanel.tsx has a Sources heading and empty state, but the control that opens the inspector beside the conversation was not found.

S7.07.needs: a Free or paid account with a code session
S7.07.note: The code workspace panels (CodeChangesPanel and the draft terminal or side panel) exist in apps/web/features/code/CloudCodePage.tsx, but the entry path from the chat screen was not confirmed.

S7.08.note: The code page's entry path from the sidebar was not confirmed; the Cmd/Ctrl-click split is in apps/web/features/code/components/CodeRail.tsx.
steps: Open the code page with at least two sessions in the session list.
Click one session, then Cmd-click (or Ctrl-click) a second session to open it in a second pane.
Click the button labelled Place panes side by side if the panes are stacked.
Use each pane: type in one, then the other, and check both stay live and usable.
S7.08.where: Code session list: Cmd-click (Ctrl-click) a second session, then use the pane button Place panes side by side

S7.09.note: The stacked layout styles are in apps/web/features/code/CloudCodePage.module.css; the code page's entry path was not confirmed.
steps: Open the code page with at least two sessions in the session list.
Cmd-click (or Ctrl-click) a second and a third session to open them as panes.
Click the button labelled Stack panes to place them one above another.
Check each stacked session is live and usable on its own.
S7.09.where: Code session list: Cmd-click (Ctrl-click) several sessions, then use the pane button Stack panes

S7.11.needs: an artifact or research panel open
S7.11.note: Keyboard resizing is implemented in apps/web/features/chat/components/SidePanelResizeHandle.tsx. The work-session panel label was not confirmed.
steps: Open an artifact or a research panel beside the conversation.
Drag the thin handle on the panel edge labelled Resize artifacts panel (or Resize research panel).
Release, then check the conversation column gets narrower or wider.
Click the handle, press the Left or Right arrow key, and check the panel width changes.
S7.11.where: Open the artifacts panel or the research panel, then drag its left edge labelled Resize artifacts panel or Resize research panel

S7.12.note: The collapse state lives in apps/web/shared/stores/layout-store.ts; the text of the sidebar button itself was taken from the translation keys.
steps: Sign in and look at the left sidebar.
Use the control labelled Collapse sidebar to hide it.
Check the conversation area widens and the sidebar is gone.
Use the control labelled Toggle sidebar or Open navigation to bring it back.
S7.12.where: Sidebar > Collapse sidebar (or Toggle sidebar); on narrow screens, Open navigation

S7.15.note: Expected says the editor takes the whole screen, but the code only grows the composer to min(60dvh, 40rem) (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ComposerInput.tsx); it does not go full screen.
steps: Type a long prompt in the message box.
Click the button labelled Expand message input.
Check the editor gets taller so you can edit more text at once.
Click the same button again (its label changes when expanded) and check the editor returns to its normal height.

S7.16.note: The path to open a research report from the chat was not traced; the desktop copy is apps/desktop/src/features/research/DeepResearchPage.tsx.
steps: Open a research report in the chat.
Click the button titled Full screen.
Read the report in the full-screen view and check it fills the window.
Click Exit full screen to return to the chat.
S7.16.where: Research report > Full screen (exit with Exit full screen)

S7.17.note: The close and zoom controls were not read by label; they are in the same file.
steps: Ask for an image, or open a conversation that already has one.
Click the image in the message.
Check the image opens in a full-screen viewer over the chat, with a Download image button.
Close the viewer and check you are back at the same place in the chat.
S7.17.where: Chat > click an image in a message to open it in the viewer; close it from the chat

steps: Open a long conversation.
Scroll the transcript up and down.
Check the composer stays fixed at the bottom while the messages scroll above it.
S7.20.where: Layout rule; visible when a conversation is long enough to scroll

S7.21.note: Resting maximum height is 240px and expanded maximum is min(60dvh, 40rem), per apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ComposerInput.tsx.
steps: Click the message box and type a long prompt over several lines.
Check the box grows taller as you type, up to a maximum height.
Click Expand message input to make the editor taller still.
Check the text stays readable and the send button stays usable.
S7.21.where: Chat composer > type a long prompt > Expand message input

S7.22.needs: a long conversation and an open side panel
S7.22.note: Scroll regions are set in apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx and apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/ChatMessageList.tsx.
steps: Open a long conversation and open a side panel such as the artifacts panel.
Scroll only the transcript and check the header, side panel and composer stay where they are.
Scroll the side panel and check the transcript does not move.
S7.22.where: Layout rule; visible when a side panel is open and the transcript is long

S7.23.note: The sticky rule itself was not read in the code, only the toolbar controls.
steps: Open an artifact so its viewer shows.
Scroll the artifact content down.
Check the toolbar (download, view and close controls) stays visible at the top.
Click Close artifact viewer to close it.
S7.23.where: Open an artifact > the viewer toolbar with Close artifact viewer; scroll the artifact body

S7.24.needs: a conversation with a long table
S7.24.note: The sticky header class is in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/MarkdownContent.tsx.
steps: Open a message with a long table, such as a table in a report.
Scroll the page or the table down.
Check the table header row stays pinned at the top.
S7.24.where: Table header rule; visible when a long table is in a message

S7.25.needs: an open side panel and a window that can be resized
S7.25.note: The overlay switch is in ArtifactsPanel.tsx and WorkSessionPanel.tsx; the exact width breakpoint was not read.
steps: Open the artifacts panel beside the conversation.
Make the window narrow, about a phone width.
Check the panel appears over the conversation as an overlay or sheet.
Widen the window and check the panel returns beside the conversation.
S7.25.where: Layout rule; visible when the window is narrowed with a panel open

S7.26.note: Drawer use is in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ComposerFooter.tsx; the picker's visible title text was not read.
steps: Open the app on a phone-sized window or a phone.
Tap the model picker in the chat composer footer.
Check it opens as a bottom sheet that slides up, not a small desktop popover.
Close it by swiping down or tapping outside, and check it returns to the chat.
S7.26.where: Composer footer model picker at phone width (a menu or picker opens as a bottom drawer)

S7.27.needs: a tablet-width window or an iPad
steps: Open the app in a window about tablet width (around 768 to 1024 px).
Check navigation and content show as two columns side by side.
Compare with a phone-width window, which shows a single column.
S7.27.where: Layout rule; visible at tablet width

S7.28.needs: a phone with a notch or home indicator
S7.28.note: Safe-area rules are in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx, apps/web/app/globals.css and apps/web/app/layout.tsx.
steps: On a phone, open a chat and check the composer is not under the home indicator.
Tap the message box so the on-screen keyboard opens.
Check the composer moves up above the keyboard and the transcript stays usable.
S7.28.where: Layout rule; visible on a phone with a notch or home indicator and the on-screen keyboard

steps: Open the artifacts panel or research panel.
Drag its edge as far left as it goes, then check the panel stops at its minimum width.
Drag it as far right as it goes, then check the panel stops at its maximum width and the conversation keeps some width.
S7.29.where: Resize limit rule; visible when dragging a side panel edge to the far limits

S7.30.note: Only the sidebar state is persisted under the agi-ui-store key in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/stores/uiStore.ts; panel widths and open panels were not confirmed as persisted.
steps: Collapse the sidebar using Collapse sidebar.
Resize a side panel and open another one.
Reload the page or close and reopen the browser tab.
Check the sidebar is still collapsed and the panel width and open panels are as you left them.
S7.30.where: Saved layout choice; visible after collapsing the sidebar and reloading the page

S7.32.note: The title menu's trigger control was not identified by a visible label; print flow is in apps/web/features/chat/lib/print-conversation.ts.
steps: Open a conversation with a few messages.
Open the conversation's title menu and choose Print.
In the print preview, check there is no sidebar or header, the whole transcript is included, and the colours suit paper.
Check the page breaks fall between messages.
